coverage_limits: No native CLI, full check.sh, canonical build, GUI, CAD save, git command/mutation, other-worktree edit, peer current-round report read, child agent or implementation fix was performed.

This lens reviews saved placement/mechanics and current integration procedures. It does not independently requalify electrical copper, firmware, all-part tolerances or supplier manufacturing capability.

The bare-bore OQ-1 benchmark is distinct from P2 wall/two-axis wire-room geometry: at nominal wire z5 the latter is4.429406mm, not5.003012mm. Actual opening height, ferrule, insulation, bend, screwdriver, staking and installed harness fit remain unqualified, as already disclosed.

Pin-tail independent envelopes assume seated terminals, maker maximum3.8mm tail length and conservative1.05mm square transverse extent; solder meniscus, actual seating, assembly tolerances and physical retained geometry are unmeasured.

No complete sled/vehicle assembly CAD was opened. Read-only parent VEHICLE supplies bore/shroud/free-length values and explicitly says its assembly is stale. Battery capacity alternatives2.6/4Ah, external modules/antennas, recovery hardware and actual full stack are unqualified.

Plate D5/D10, material/mass assumptions, rigid sled and point supports are inference. Static100g is not shock or vibration; default4mm standoffs and <=1mm plate are a starting stack, not qualified hardware.5x100g capacities, post-staking response, U4/U5 stress/thermal bias, closed-card retention and open-lid access require physical tests.

Only the closed microSD/card union is bounded. Open sweep is not maker-dimensioned. Current procedure properly requires off/disconnected/out-of-bay and PCB removal from a continuous sled or a qualified window.
No AGENTS section2 violation was established in this assigned lens; physical/firmware qualification remains separate and open.
